batch: Sysinternals Suite current-source package lifecycle regression
harnessHistory: An initial combined invocation for the Suite and independent product suites stopped before discovery because the Pester configuration used an invalid Plugins.TestRegistry property path.
A corrected combined invocation discovered 80 tests but produced no completed result before it was interrupted after several minutes; no aggregate outcome is claimed for that invocation.
The isolated Suite invocation completed all eight assertions successfully with TestRegistry and TestResult disabled.

migrationDisposition.sysinternalsLicense: The prior RIDE v2 license-specialist approval remains authoritative for RIDE's direct download-and-install workflow; licensing is not a migration gate.
migrationDisposition.defenderExclusions: PasswordScan x86/x64 and other user-reported Defender-blocked tools remain separately excluded.
partial: Current-source local package lifecycle regression passed 8/8; this adds no native acceptance or legacy-outcome closure.
deferred: Native acceptance remains governed by existing Windows 11 evidence and does not expand from this local regression.

estimates.adjustment: None; the regression rechecks current-source behavior without closing another legacy package outcome.
